author: Justin420
quote: I have enjoyed this game beginning to end! The atmosphere was top notch and kept me on the edge of my seat pretty much all the way through. The story alone is worth the experience and fits the silent hill franchise so well. The combat isn’t anything special but not the worst thing ever but for the most part it’s recommended to play it stealthily even though combat is an option especially when caught and cornered. Overall I enjoyed this game so much and looking forward to future Silent Hill games definitely recommend this game!
